entities.summary: Zoilo Manuel Almonte is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees, in the KBO League for the KT Wiz, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons.
